title: Fresh & Light
summary: Raw crunch, citrus, and minimal fat — season aggressively because there is less fat to carry salt.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — fresh & light is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: acid, herb, texture. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Umami anchor (fish sauce, parmesan) stops "diet food" blandness.
